name: Omarchief
author: daventhedude
description: Your desktop's chief of staff: a creature that sits in the corner and takes orders. Click it, type what you want, and it does the thing and answers in a speech bubble — the console is one right-click away, carrying the same conversation. It wears your theme and tells you how the day is going with its face.

barWidget.description: Status and controls for the desktop chief: ask, console, send it home or to another screen, have it do something, and see when the agent stops answering.
